subject.title: cli-backend agent runs against anthropic (claude-cli runtime) return 401 authentication_failed while identical claude invocation works in shell

question: Should this issue stay separate pending maintainer-run macOS LaunchAgent Claude CLI OAuth proof, or be folded into the narrower Claude CLI expired-token recovery work?
rationale: The reporter's trace is detailed and matches current source, but the distinct claim depends on live Claude CLI OAuth, launchd service context, loopback MCP, and local credential/keychain state that this read-only review could not reproduce.

options.title: Require service-context proof
options.body: Run a maintainer-controlled macOS LaunchAgent comparison before changing Claude CLI env, MCP, or credential behavior, and keep this issue open as the tracked proof target.

options.title: Fold into expired-token recovery
options.body: If live proof shows the failure is only the already-tracked expired-token 401 guidance gap, use the canonical fix for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/97553 and then close this issue as covered.

options.title: Sponsor source-trace patch
options.body: Accept the reporter's trace as enough to sponsor a targeted runtime/auth fix now, with higher regression risk around env isolation and MCP behavior.

recommendation.title: Require service-context proof
recommendation.body: Run a maintainer-controlled macOS LaunchAgent comparison before changing Claude CLI env, MCP, or credential behavior, and keep this issue open as the tracked proof target.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Anthropic CLI auth/runtime history makes this the strongest routing signal for the proof and fix-boundary decision.
